## Setup — 2 things to replace before activating

1. Replace `YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID` in the URL with the Google Sheet's file ID (the long string in its URL between `/d/` and `/edit`).
2. Attach your own Google Sheets OAuth2 credential (Predefined Credential Type). It needs edit access to the sheet.

What this does every 1 minute:
- Writes the current timestamp into the Dashboard's `Heartbeat_Cell` (C6). That edit forces Google Sheets to recalculate every formula, including the TODAY()-based ones (Leasing Pipeline / Growth sections) that otherwise only refresh on open or on Sheets' own periodic auto-recalc.

This workflow only keeps the sheet's computed values fresh — it doesn't fetch or send data anywhere. Your backend reads the KPI_*/PM_Workload_Table named ranges directly via the Sheets API (spreadsheets.values.batchGet, passing the named range names as the `ranges` params) whenever it needs the current numbers; by the time it calls, this heartbeat has already made sure the sheet has recalculated within the last minute.

(AppsScript/Code.gs in this repo is still available as an optional plain-JSON endpoint if some other, non-backend consumer ever wants a simple GET — it's just no longer part of this workflow.)
